about: UCT Agent REAL-MODEL BENCH v1 (2026-11-22, W1): natural, unfamiliar Charts requests for the paid real-model baseline. Written fresh: no phrasing copied from corpus / dev-nl1 / heldout sets (agentRealModelBench.test.js checks). Scored by OUTCOME (testing/bench.js benchOutcome), not by plan text. corpus.json library + the boards below (drawings on). Format: testing/sets.js + bench.js fields (mix, fam, expect.notOn, expect.extraOk, $has/$in args). docs/agent/program/EVAL.md section 4.
